title: A local closed free model at a maximal-ideal-annihilated generic stalk
statement: Let X be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], i:Z -> X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] with Z integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], and F a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Suppose the stalk F_x at x=i(genericPoint Z) [def-weil-irreducible-components, def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is killed by the maximal ideal of O_{X,x} [def-weil-residue-field]. There are an integer r >= 0 and an open U of X containing x, with an isomorphism (i_*(O_Z^{direct sum r}))|U isomorphic to F|U. No global map or ideal lattice is asserted.

source.place: Tag 01YE, proof through the local free model, before applying Tag 01YB.

proof.text: Let xi be the generic point of Z, R = O_X,i(xi), K = O_Z,xi, and M = F_i(xi). The closed immersion gives a surjective ring map phi : R -> K; Mathlib makes K a field for integral Z and ker_eq_maximalIdeal identifies its kernel with the maximal ideal of R. The hypothesis hkill makes M torsion by this kernel. Construct its quotient-ring module action with Module.IsTorsionBySet.module, then its K-action through the inverse of phi.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective. The quotient formula proves phi(a) acts on M as a does. These are actual constructions, not chosen witnesses.

Coherence gives F finite type. finite_moduleStalk_of_isFiniteType supplies Module.Finite R M. The identity semilinear map over phi transfers this to Module.Finite K M by Module.Finite.of_surjective. Set r = Module.finrank K M, take Module.finBasis, and reindex by ULift (Fin r). Combine its equivFun with exists_finite_free_moduleStalk_linearEquiv to give an isomorphism E_xi -> M over K, where E = free (ULift (Fin r)). This performs the finite generic basis step directly over the residue field and includes r = 0.

Prove the finite free closed-pushforward model coherent in the private helper isCoherent_closedImmersion_finiteFree. E has an explicit finite presentation with empty relations. To show i_*E quasi-coherent, apply isQuasicoherent_of_forall_isAffineOpen: the two basic-open localization conditions for E on i^{-1}(W) transfer using i.preimage_basicOpen and i.naturality. Its sections on each affine W are finite over Gamma(Z,i^{-1}(W)) since E is finitely presented, and therefore finite over Gamma(X,W) since i.app W is surjective. The private affine_restrict_sections equivalence transports these sections to the restriction along W.fromSpec. Over the Noetherian coordinate ring, exists_presentation_isFinite gives a finite global presentation. Affine opens cover X; isFinitePresentation_of_iSup_opensRange_eq_top gives finite presentation of i_*E, and the locally Noetherian coherence criterion concludes. The affine finiteness and finite-presentation facts here are the proved upstream declarations finite_sections_of_isFinitePresentation, exists_presentation_isFinite, and isFinitePresentation_of_iSup_opensRange_eq_top, not an application of quasicoherent_finite_type_affine.

The closed-pushforward stalk comparison is bijective and linear through i.stalkMap xi. Package it with LinearEquiv.ofBijective as an isomorphism (i_*E)_i(xi) -> restrictScalars(phi)(E_xi). Apply restriction of scalars to the basis isomorphism. The identity additive equivalence on M is R-linear because phi(a) acts as a, proved in step 1. Compose these three isomorphisms to give (i_*E)_i(xi) isomorphic to F_i(xi), without descending F or its annihilator subsheaf.

The proved private helper coherent_stalk_iso_near applies exists_open_hom_of_coherent_stalk_map to the coherent modules i_*E and F on X. Its equality expresses the original stalk isomorphism as the new stalk map conjugated by the bijective restriction-stalk comparisons; cancellation proves this new map bijective. Coherence restricts to the resulting U. Apply coherent_local_isomorphism on the open subscheme U to obtain W containing the lifted point on which the over-site map is invertible.

Convert the over-site isomorphism through overFunctorEquiv and overEquiv. For g = W.iota followed by U.iota, restrictFunctorComp identifies nested restrictions with restriction along g. Pull the isomorphism back along g.isoOpensRange.inv and compose restrictCompIso with g.isoOpensRange_inv_comp to obtain an isomorphism on g.opensRange, which contains i(xi). Sigma.whiskerEquiv reindexes E from ULift (Fin r) to Fin r. Pushforward and restriction transport this reindexing to exactly the coproduct in the unchanged conclusion.

proof_origin.based_on: Stacks Project Tag 01YE (read online), finite generic basis; Tags 01Y4 and 01Y3 for extension and shrinking. A direct quotient-field action replaces annihilator descent to avoid the cyclic planned imports. Finite-free closed-pushforward coherence is proved by the affine localization argument of Tags 01Y6 and 01XZ using the existing proved source-library API. Complete Lean proof, no new holes; route below the unit level. Second reader V3 checked the quotient action, finite-free pushforward proof, stalk comparison and neighbourhood transport; removed the unused quasicoherent_finite_type_affine dependency and aligned the docstring.

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_generic_local_free_model
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hkill : ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
      (X.presheaf.stalk (i.base (genericPoint Z))),
      ∀ m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace
        (i.base (genericPoint Z))).obj F, a • m = 0) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (U : X.Opens), i.base (genericPoint Z) ∈ U ∧
      Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin r => SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) ≅
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F)
